references.summary: defaultExtension stores the final extension. The custom select value is a temporary presentation state, not a separate customExtension option. Blur lowercases, trims, selects the leading dot-separated [a-z0-9_-] prefix and removes one leading dot.

Glob syntax is *, **, **/, ?, bracket classes; slash patterns match mount-relative paths, other patterns basename. Supported files are the initial inclusion. Any matching ! exclusion wins regardless of order. Mac matching is case-sensitive. Invalid classes can throw in original; replica ignores invalid patterns.

SupportedFiles consists of 15 Markdown/plain text extensions plus empty extension. defaultExtension is appended by setDefaultExtension. Thus a multi-dot custom extension is used for save names but matching still uses the final extension component.

Non-hidden files/directories are admitted before mode filtering. Directories remain visible independent of file pattern matches. node_modules is ignored except tree all. Current replica keeps existing package/symlink traversal rather than claiming full filesystem parity.
can_collapse_outline_panel toggles the no-collapse-outline class and updates the live outline.
The outline has independent expander and label actions. Label navigation opens its branch. The hidden outline filter is a context-menu action, not a default-visible extra input.
On first collapsible outline population, only a single root is opened automatically. Existing open branch state is retained during refresh.
When the active heading is within a collapsed branch, the visible ancestor is highlighted. Explicit highlight can expand ancestors.

scope: Read-only behavior references for independent Files preferences/sidebar implementation. This is not full GUI or native-factory-default proof.
